A repeated Slow card ordinarily resolves in Slow. A repeated card does not grant its printed card Elements again, though an effect that explicitly grants Elements grants them again. Gift has no additional Repeat payment; Powerstorm requires paying the card’s cost again.

evidence.text: Retain changes to the Power, including extra Range or changed speed. An ordinary Repeat uses the Power's **most recently assigned speed**: a Slow Power repeats in Slow even if its permission came from a Fast Power; a formerly Fast Power explicitly made Slow before repeating now repeats in Slow. An instruction to Repeat immediately instead follows that explicit timing, directly after the originating use. A Repeat activates a Power's effects again; it is not a second card play and grants no additional printed card Elements. It **does** count as another Power use. A card mixing a global instruction with “each” instructions is one overall action with nested actions per “each”; complete that whole action tree before checking outcomes. Separate each-player removal allowances cannot be pooled. [FAQ scaling-removal-of-health-worth-of-invaders]

“Damage” means **Damage to Invaders** unless explicitly stated otherwise. Normal Spirit Damage does not harm Dahan or the land. Distribute Damage among Invaders in the target land however you wish; Explorers need not be hit first. Damage from separate normal Powers and counterattacks can accumulate within a turn. A piece is destroyed immediately when its marked Damage reaches/exceeds its Health. Reduced Health can also destroy a previously damaged piece; Damage does not itself reduce Health. If a damaged piece moves out of a Health bonus or into a Health penalty and is thereby destroyed, destruction occurs in its destination land, never in an in-between location.
